candidate: Replicated exact-safe-vector read heads validating reuse of complete cached Datalog query results; heads contain metadata only, not graph facts.
isolation: Candidate code, conformance adapter, tests and benchmark remained in a separate worktree based exactly on 529f475. No candidate storage code was merged into the canonical checkout.

durableCompatibilityChange.scope: Explicit opt-in only. First head join advances the durable g-facade protocol marker from 2 to 3 as an old-writer fence; the candidate accepts 2/3 and the prior code predicate rejects 3. No source fact, transaction payload, index, projection, public query or public API wire format is rewritten.
durableCompatibilityChange.compatibility: This is a persisted control-plane marker change; it is not a transparent zero-migration replacement. The candidate is therefore not selected for canonical use.

conformance.readHeadCoverage: The conformance-only InspectionFacadeDO joins one active durable head for every graph before its first query cut. The multi-clause 401-row bag-join case requires repeated exact result reuse after same-snapshot validation; after replacement/retraction it requires canonical fallback and an exact fresh result. Session compares full bags to its independent reference Model. The conformance suite exercises writes, replay identity, crash/recovery, read faults, and nested topology while the candidate is enabled.

localPerformance.runtime: Miniflare/workerd with local SQLite and native RPC; no hosted Cloudflare access
limitations: One bounded local trial, 64 measured samples per query/placement; p99 is sample max, not a tail bound.
Combined offered concurrency was 128; observed in-flight max was 64 due local Worker/harness behavior.
The 8-head placement shows zero canonical read-cut calls during repeat rounds, but no dependable general latency gain: point p99 changes from 8.49 to 7.95 ms, combined p99 from 30.83 to 32.93 ms.
The 500 post-publication point queries were exact snapshot 2/cacheHits 1 at observed concurrency 128; they do not establish hosted performance or unique-query scaling.
The single two-fact publication took 36.62 ms; no baseline write comparison or broad write throughput conclusion is supported.

tlaps.scope: Three local read-head lemmas; not whole-protocol safety, liveness, batching, implementation or performance

formal.tlc: Historical publication/routing model runs are retained under formal/historical-*.json. A fresh TLC attempt on the port worktree stopped before execution because TLA2TOOLS_JAR is unavailable; exact attempt: formal/tlc/attempt.txt.
formal.scopeCaveat: The formal models do not establish whole-protocol implementation refinement, hosted performance, liveness under platform failures, or unconditional availability.

failedLocalAttempts.note: All unsuccessful local attempts have their full reports/source inputs in local-runs/. Each used a fresh temporary persistence directory and unique run ID. No operation was replayed against an uncertain state; only successful run 67e89a24-b9f1-473a-b6cc-cc84f5c3b4bd supplies performance results.

recommendation: Do not select for canonical storage. The port now has correctness evidence on the requested 529f475 baseline and demonstrates exact repeated-query cut-RPC elimination, but a single small trial shows negligible/slightly mixed p99 behavior while adding a durable opt-in schema marker fence and synchronous publication fan-out before acknowledgement. Retain as research; require a product decision on the persisted control marker, hosted/representative workload evidence, and further write-path profiling before any reconsideration.
